name: Leena Tewari
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2016-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026); Hurun India (2017-2022)
forbes_bio: The media-shy heir of a pharma fortune, Leena Tewari chairs privately held USV India, which her late father Vithal Gandhi set up with Revlon in 1961.
USV specializes in diabetic and cardiovascular drugs, with a portfolio that spans biosimilar drugs, injectables and active pharmaceutical ingredients.
The Mumbai company is run by her husband, Prashant, an Indian Institute of Technology grad and mechanical engineer from Cornell University.
Her daughter Aneesha Gandhi Tewari, who has a Ph.D. in molecular biology from MIT,  and son Vilas, who founded a gaming outfit in Los Angeles, both have board seats at USV.
forbes_facts: Tewari loves animals and travels into forests across India.
In 2018, USV acquired German generics firm Juta Pharma for an undisclosed sum.

name: Zhang Hongfu
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2022-2026); Hurun China (2021-2026); Hurun Global U40 (2022-2023); Hurun China U40 (2021-2022); Hurun Unicorn founders (2022-2024)
forbes_bio: Zhang Hongfu is the CEO of Mixue Group, the world's second biggest seller of freshly-made drinks by annual cups sold after Starbucks.
His elder brother Hongchao started a shaved ice shop in 1997 in China and opened the first Mixue Bingcheng store two years later. Hongfu joined in 2007.

Nearly all-franchised, the Mixue Bingcheng chain offers bubble tea, lemonade, coffee and other drinks as well as ice cream at dirt-cheap prices across more than 50,000 stores, including nearly 5,000 overseas.
The company went public in a $444 million Hong Kong IPO in March 2025.
Hongchao is the chairman of the company and also a billionaire.

name: Greg Love
forbes_bio: Greg Love and brother Frank are co-CEOs of Love's Travel Stops & Country Stores, a truck stop and convenience store chains with over 600 locations in 42 states.
Love started working for the company in high school.
The $22 billion (est. sales) company was founded by his parents, Tom and Judy Love, in 1964.
Sister Jenny Love Meyer is chief culture officer and EVP; sister Laura has no role at the company.

name: Girdharilal Bawri
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2020); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Hurun India (2017-2021)
forbes_bio: Girdharilal Bawri is the chairman of Macleods Pharmaceuticals, which is among India's top 10 pharma firms.
Bawri, whose family owned a pharmacy in Jaipur, set up Macleods Pharmaceuticals in 1986 with his two siblings to make anti-TB medicines.
Macleods produces generics for a range of diseases including asthma, osteoporosis and diabetes.
His younger brothers, Rajendra Agrawal and Banwarilal Bawri, are managing director and joint managing director respectively.
forbes_facts: Bawri and his two siblings live together with their families in the same building in Mumbai.
The company was named after John Macleod, a Scottish doctor and author of medical textbooks.

name: Zahan Mistry
forbes_bio: Zahan Mistry is the son of the late Cyrus Mistry, the former chairman of Tata Sons, the holding company of the Tata conglomerate.
He inherited part of his family's 18.4% stake in Tata Sons after his father died in a car crash in 2022.
His uncle Shapoor Mistry  is chairman of the family's Mumbai construction giant, Shapoorji Pallonji Group.
To reduce debt, the group raised a $646 million by listing privately held construction and engineering firm Afcons Infrastructure in 2024.

name: Xue Hua
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026); Hurun China (2008-2026)
forbes_bio: Xue Hua is cofounder and chairman of Guangdong Haid Group, a supplier of animal feed products.
Haid employs 20,000 people.
Xue graduated from Huazhong Agricultural University with a major in aquaculture in 1992.

name: Robert Friedland
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2004-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Robert Friedland is founder and executive cochairman of Toronto-listed Ivanhoe Mines, a leader in the mining and precious metals industry.
Based in Singapore, Friedland is praised for finding profitable mines in remote areas like Oyu Tolgoi in Mongolia.
A graduate of Reed College, Friedland also funds Ivanhoe Capital, which invests in emerging markets.
He also has a stake in Australia-listed Clean TeQ Holdings, which supplies cobalt and nickel to lithium-ion battery producers.
Friedland's Ivanhoe Atlantic, formerly High Power Exploration, plans to invest $5 billion in infrastructure projects in Africa's Liberty Corridor, connecting Guinea to Liberia.
forbes_facts: Friedland's son Govind is a geologist and founder of uranium mining outfit GoviEx Uranium.
Friedland owns Ivanhoe Pictures, a production company that merged with Sidney Kimmel Entertainment to form SK Global.
His Canada-based Peregrine Diamonds was acquired in 2018 by De Beers Group for around $80 million.

name: Sheryl Sandberg
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Sheryl Sandberg served as chief operating officer of Facebook, now Meta, from 2008 until the fall of 2022.
She stepped down from Meta's board in 2024.
Sandberg and her husband, Tom Bernthal, launched Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners in 2021 to invest their own capital in startups.
Sandberg is the author of the bestselling books "Lean In: Women, Work, and the Will to Lead" and "Lean In for Graduates."
The Harvard MBA was previously an economist at the World Bank and chief of staff to then U.S. Treasury Secretary Larry Summers.
forbes_facts: Sandberg was previously vice president of online sales and operations at Google and a management consultant at McKinsey & Co.
Sandberg married Tom Bernthal, who was CEO of a consulting agency, in 2022.

name: Ajay Parekh
forbes_bio: Ajay Parekh is non-executive vice chairman of Pidilite Industries, a company founded by his late father, Balvant Parekh, in 1959.
He has a minority stake in Pidilite, which is India's leading maker of adhesives and sealants.
His older brother Madhukar Parekh, also a billionaire, is chairman of Pidilite.
Pidilite's range of products includes construction chemicals, art materials and organic pigments.
In 2020, Pidilite acquired the Indian subsidiary of U.S.-based Huntsman Group for $290 million.
forbes_facts: Pidilite is best known for its iconic white glue, Fevicol, popularized over the decades with clever advertising.

name: Per Sandberg
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2025); Hurun Global (2026)
forbes_bio: Per Sandberg is a major shareholder in pharmaceutical company Camurus, which develops treatment for opiod dependency.
He inherited the stakes from his father, entrepreneur Gunnar Sandberg.
He is also the sole owner of Aimpoint ? the world leader in red dot sights for hunting, sport shooting, and military use.
Sandberg Development is his family-owned investment company, focusing on water technology, quality of life, and security.
Per Sandberg has three siblings, all of whom have been bought out of Sandberg Development. He now owns the company together with his three sons.

name: Larry Robbins
sec_insider_companies: CVS HEALTH Corp (CVS) - Director; Butterfly Network, Inc. (BFLY) - Director
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2014-2025); Hurun Global (2016-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026)
forbes_bio: Larry Robbins is founder and CEO of Glenview Capital Management, a New York hedge fund that oversees $2.6 billion in assets.
Robbins is known for his hot and cold streaks, with his returns swinging wildly from one year to the next.
Through his Robbins Family Foundation, he is an active supporter of education reform both in New York City and on the national level.
In 2017, Robbins began serving as chairman of the Robin Hood Foundation, which fights poverty in New York City.
forbes_facts: Robbins named his firm Glenview after the town outside Chicago where his childhood hockey team practiced.
Robbins, who played hockey at the University of Pennsylvania, built an indoor hockey rink next to his house in New Jersey.

name: Liu Chang
appears_on: Hurun Self-Made Women (2017-2022); Hurun Unicorn founders (2019-2020)

name: T. Satishkumar
forbes_bio: T.Satishkumar chairs and runs Milky Mist Dairy Food, an Indian maker of dairy products such as cottage cheese and curd.
The company's IPO in August 2026 made him a billionaire.
Milky Mist's investors include Singapore's Temasek and International Finance Corp.
He joined his father's milk distribution business at age 16 and transformed it into dairy products company.
His wife Anitha is a director on the company's board.
